risks.risk: Agent blackboards become authoritative world storage
risks.control: GameState owns physical/domain truth; blackboards receive observations only.

risks.risk: MonoGame lifecycle and types leak into simulation
risks.control: Headless Core tests and immutable presentation snapshots; MonoGame stays an adapter.

risks.risk: Dominatus save is mistaken for a complete game save
risks.control: Use ISaveChunkContributor for one versioned game-domain chunk; never rely on BbJsonCodec for domain records.

risks.risk: Aurelian sprite work expands the first playable milestone
risks.control: Use MonoGame temporarily; qualify Aurelian separately.

risks.risk: Machina cannot yet composite with a game surface or arbitrate input
risks.control: Keep M1 headless; add one host adapter later.

risks.risk: Godot navigation/node ownership contaminates game truth
risks.control: Use deterministic game-local grid/A* and avoid Godot as the chosen host.

risks.risk: Runtime inspection makes Oblivion product truth
risks.control: Export compact read-only snapshots into existing cards.

risks.risk: Unseeded or framework RNG breaks replay
risks.control: Game-local explicit PRNG state is saved and hashed.
